messages:
alex_p: Quick sync — CedarBridge dedicated rollout needs final go/no-go. Target window: 2025-09-15 02:00-03:00 UTC. Pinning tenant to runtime v1.9.2 and model set rwd-ggml-3b-quant. Need approvals for pin + traffic shift plan.

liz_h: Ack. Can you paste the exact pin config? Also do we have smoke tests and rollback thresholds documented? :eyes:

alex_p: Config below:
```
tenant: cedarbridge
deployment: dedicated-pool-eu-2
runtime_version: v1.9.2
models:
  - name: rwd-ggml-3b-quant
    pinned: true
traffic_shift:
  strategy: step
  steps: [10, 30, 60, 100]
  step_interval: 10m
rollback:
  error_rate_threshold: 3.0  # percent
  latency_p90_threshold_ms: 1200
```
Smoke tests: quick prompt/eval harness (health-check + perf). Runbook: r/cedarbridge-rollout (internal doc).

raj: I ran a dry-run against staging last night — KV cache warmup looks fine, steady 10% batch hit. Recommend reducing first step to 5% if we want safer ramp. Also suggest adding a hot-fail fallback to rwd-ggml-2b.

deploy-bot: @channel preflight checks started for rollout 1968254321-cedarbridge
- infra health: OK
- pool capacity: OK (reserved 4/4 gpus)
- model artifacts: OK
- canary smoke run: queued

sam: +1 on lowering first step to 5%. CedarBridge has tight SLAs. Also confirm the canary keys are isolated and logs are forwarded to cedarbridge-log-sink.

alex_p: Updating plan: steps [5, 20, 50, 100], step_interval 12m, fallback model rwd-ggml-2b, canary keys = cedarbridge-canary-*. Logs -> cedarbridge-log-sink. Updated runbook section: "canary verification checklist".

liz_h: I need an explicit rollback trigger: either error_rate >= 3% sustained over 2 intervals OR p90 >= 1200ms over 2 intervals. Also add operator manual override for immediate rollback. If that matches, I'm good to approve.

ops_oncall: Confirmed monitoring: SLO dashboards - cedarbridge/latency and /errors, alert channel #incidents-cedarbridge, alert thresholds wired. Manual rollback command is `redwood rollback --tenant cedarbridge --to-model rwd-ggml-2b` in runbook.

maria: Heads-up: we'll coordinate the DB maintenance window at 02:30 UTC. It shouldn't block traffic shift but might add noise; recommend avoiding full shift at that minute.

alex_p: Noted — we'll avoid stepping during 02:25-02:35. Final plan attached in runbook.

liz_h: Approving pin + traffic shift plan assuming first step 5% and rollback triggers as written. :thumbsup:

raj: Approving from SRE side. I'll be on-call for the window. I'll run the canary smoke and validate analytics event coverage. :white_check_mark:

ops_oncall: Approving operations/Rollback path verified. I'll be ready to execute if needed.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: cedarbridge -> dedicated-pool-eu-2
Start: 2025-09-15T02:00:00Z
Steps: [5,20,50,100] @ 12m intervals
Fallback: rwd-ggml-2b
Canary: cedarbridge-canary-*
Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/cedarbridge-rollout
Requested by: alex_p
Approvals: liz_h, raj, ops_oncall

alex_p: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post a short release note to #customer-updates after we hit 100%.

liz_h: One more note: Lock tenant config for 24h post-rollout to prevent accidental version drift. Can infra enforce that?

infra_bot: Lock applied: tenant cedarbridge config locked for 24h (expires 2025-09-16T02:00:00Z)

alex_p: Perfect. Thread closed unless there are objections. :rocket:
